title: Wasm Authoritative Selection Exit Highlight
description: Finish board selection-exit highlight: TS reads exitHighlightIds from wasm select events; descriptor JSON no longer sends selectionExitHighlightIds; setSelectionIds wasm-first then drain; Rust test asserts exit highlight from set_selection_ids not descriptor field.
summary: Selection exit secondary chrome is wasm-owned: JS applies exitHighlightIds from every select drain event, stops sending selectionExitHighlightIds in descriptor JSON, and calls setSelectionIdsJson before draining to avoid descriptor races. Rust sync_descriptor no longer replaces selection_exit_highlight from the descriptor; it prunes dead ids and emits push_select_event when selection changes. Replaced the old descriptor-fed test with set_selection_ids coverage; pub(crate) handle_world_pos and effective_handle_radius fix host test visibility.
